ways.label: Pisa Range Ridge Track from Queensberry car park

end.name: Pisa Range Conservation Area boundary just before Mitre Rocks
end.quote: terminates at the Pisa Range Conservation Area boundary just before Mitre Rocks

evidence: Start at Queensberry car park and climb the Pisa Range Ridge Track.
The track continues past Mt Dottrel at 1690 metres, and terminates at the Pisa Range Conservation Area boundary just before Mitre Rocks.
Note: There is no exit on the Mitre Rocks/Lowburn side, trampers must return same way or use alternate exits described here.

doubts: Start ref F1 is the road end where the track meets Wailana Heights Drive, where the page says the Queensberry car park is. The end is the conservation boundary, not a named place. The alternative entry/exit tracks are listed together as entry/exit points; the leave points along the ridge are not stated precisely.
